name: Blount County, TN
findings: Blount County has 311 nonprofit organizations. 131 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 101 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Blount County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 12 would.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 6 professional organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
